author: Forbes
description:
Can premium rubber allow a family minivan to out-handle a sports coupe? In this track experiment, host Scotty Reiss joins Derek Secord, Senior Subjective Test Driver at Michelin, to test a simple premise: the right tire changes everything.

To evaluate the real-world impact of budget rubber, the team pitted a Chrysler Pacifica minivan equipped with premium Michelin CrossClimate 2 all-weather tires directly against a sport-tuned BMW 4 Series running on brand-new "tier 4" cheap tires. The test took place on an aged, one-mile wet handling track engineered with continuous sprinklers to evaluate grip, control, and driver confidence at the limit.

The results delivered a stark performance contrast. The Chrysler Pacifica maintained continuous traction and steering predictability through wet slaloms and sustained hairpins, allowing the driver to confidently accelerate through corners without sliding.
